items.stem: Which railroad-crossing approach matches the stated precautions?

options.text: Race the train whenever the vehicle appears faster.
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Never race a train to the crossing, stop whenever safety is in doubt, keep space for the vehicle on the far side, and avoid shifting gears on the tracks.

options.text: Stop on the tracks to wait for room beyond them.

options.text: Do not race a train; stop if safety is doubtful and leave room beyond the tracks.
